items.source: Factory method used to create a new ConcurrentReferenceHashMap.Reference.
items.translation: 用于创建新ConcurrentReferenceHashMap.Reference的工厂方法。

items.source: Strategy class used to manage References. This class can be overridden if alternative reference types need to be supported.
items.translation: 用于管理References的 Strategy 类。如果需要支持其他类型的引用，可以重写此类。

items.source: Return any reference that has been garbage collected and can be purged from the underlying structure or null if no references need purging. This method must be thread safe and ideally should not block when returning null. References should be returned once and only once.
items.translation: 返回任何已被垃圾回收并可从底层结构清除的引用，或者如果无需清除引用则返回 null。此方法必须是线程安全的，并且在返回 null 时理想情况下不应阻塞。引用应仅被返回一次且只能返回一次。

items.source: next - the next reference in the chain, or null if none
items.translation: next - 链中的下一个引用，或者如果没有则为 null

items.source: entry - the entry contained in the reference
Return any reference that has been garbage collected and can be purged from the underlying structure or null if no references need purging.
items.translation: 返回任何已被垃圾回收并可从底层结构清除的引用，或者如果无需清除引用则返回`null`。

items.source: Phillip Webb, Juergen Hoeller, Brian Clozel
